gateScope: Four captured mixed-status static presentation samples
method: Viewed all four original full-phone PNGs directly with view_image; no screenshot processing and no phone operations.

observations.detail: 六單位冰牢內另有暖色環，角色頭臉受硬控冰牢遮蔽符合既定完整包覆規格；外框不跨鄰位，姓名/等級/HP與五個狀態圖示清楚分開。
冰牢與淡色護體同時存在，沒有合成全排大霧；玩家角色原有藍/紅/金輪廓仍部分可辨，敵方姓名及血條可辨，無溢出遮鄰位。
金色符環與冰牢疊合雖較密，範圍仍限制在單位主體；沒有蓋到名稱或HP，六個獨立位置保持，未見整隊合成大球。
金色外環較淡，主體外接範圍受控；五個圖示與姓名/血條仍可讀，未見輪替後重複累積成更多body或跨槽殘影。

decision: No new player-visible blocker demonstrated by these four mixed-status stills. Retain accepted hard-control coverage; do not reduce all effects to transparency or reopen previously accepted sources.

priorEvidence.statusStatic: 21 statuses static PASS on both sides at recorded status gate

limits: Not a performance timing run; four stills cannot certify smooth rotation, frame pacing, cleanup or endurance.
All four samples retain freeze, so this does not visually sample every possible pair among 17 configured statuses or independently revalidate each secondary identity.
